$comment: The DFPONG API: everything controllers, the game and the admin panel can send each other. This file is the one place to change it. After editing, run `node api/build.mjs` (see api/README.md).
name: DFPONG API

evolution.summary: The API grows a little every year. These rules let it change without breaking the controllers, games and admin panels already out there.
rules: The movement characteristic never changes: every controller since 2024 relies on it.
Add, don't change. New settings, names, values and messages arrive in a minor version (1.0 → 1.1). Existing ones keep their meaning.

Readers forgive. The game ignores settings it doesn't know (and lists them in its debug panel), uses the default for any value it can't use, and clamps numbers into range. Controllers and admin panels ignore fields they don't know.
Experimental items can still change or disappear without a new major version. Try them; don't build a whole project on them yet.
Deprecated items keep working for at least one more school year, and their replacement is named here.
Breaking changes need a new major version (2.0) and a new configVersion. Avoid them: old controllers will still send configVersion 1 for years.

status.stable: Safe to use. Will keep working the same way.
status.experimental: Works now, but may change or be removed in a minor version.
status.deprecated: Still works; use the replacement named in `replacedBy`.
status.planned: Reserved for a future version. Not implemented yet; the name is taken so nothing else uses it.

bluetooth.description: Each controller is a Bluetooth LE peripheral. The browser finds it by a service UUID that ends in the controller's number.
bluetooth.uuidSuffix: Two hex digits: 13 + the controller number (controller 1 → 0e, controller 242 → ff). Every 2024 controller uses 14.

movement.description: Controller → game: the paddle direction, sent as a notification when it changes. Game → controller: 3 (hello) during the handshake. The game also reads it every 1.5 s to check the controller is still there.

3.name: HANDSHAKE
3.description: hello: sent by the controller until the game writes a 3 back

movement.otherValues: Treated as NEUTRAL by every game version.

config.description: The controller's settings as one JSON object (see `settings`). The game reads it when connecting, and reads it again whenever the controller notifies a change.

actions.description: Controller → game: things that happen during play, as small packets (see `actions`). Older games don't subscribe, so a controller can always have it.

handshakeRepeatMs.description: how often a controller repeats its hello until the game answers

subscribeTimeoutMs.description: how long a controller waits for the game to subscribe after connecting

handshakeTimeoutMs.description: how long a controller waits for the handshake after the game subscribes

aliveCheckMs.description: how often the game checks a connected controller still answers

aliveTimeoutMs.description: how long the controller has to answer a check

aliveStrikes.description: missed checks in a row before the game reconnects (and pauses a match)

settings.$comment: Keys in a controller's settings JSON. kind: player (only changes your side) or request (a shared game rule, settled with the other player when the match starts). changes: when a change during a match takes effect, see `liveChanges` and `changeGroups`.

name.label: Name
name.description: The controller's name in the game. A controllerName in the class list comes first; without either, the game uses the person's name from the class list.

color.label: Color
color.description: Paddle and trail color: "#rrggbb" or any CSS color name. Very dark colors are brightened so the paddle stays visible.

paddleSize.label: Paddle size
paddleSize.description: Paddle height in percent of normal.

hitSound.label: Hit sound
hitSound.description: Played when your paddle hits the puck: a built-in sound name (see `sounds`) or an https:// link to a short sound file.

winSound.label: Win sound
winSound.description: Played when you win the match.

music.label: Music
music.description: Background music for your matches: a track name (see `music`) or an https:// link. If both players bring music, the host chooses one or the game alternates each point.

pointsToWin.label: Points to win
pointsToWin.description: Asks to play to this many points.

puckSpeed.label: Puck speed
puckSpeed.description: Asks for this starting puck speed. 5 is normal.

speedIncrement.label: Speed-up per hit
speedIncrement.description: Asks for this much extra puck speed after every hit.

changeGroups.match: Shared with the other player (rule requests, music): always waits for the next match.

liveChanges.$comment: House setting: when a controller's changes take effect during a match.

instant.label: Right away
instant.help: Everything a controller changes applies at once, even in the middle of a rally.

point.label: Between points
point.help: Colors, names and sounds change at once. Paddle speed and size wait for the next serve.

match.label: Next match
match.help: Nothing a controller changes applies until the match is over.

permissions.$comment: House setting: which kinds of settings controllers may use. Each setting names its permission.

taunts.label: In Game Actions
taunts.description: Taunts (and later in-game actions such as power-ups). Steering with a knob is always allowed: it's a way to move, like buttons.

actions.$comment: Packets on the actions characteristic: byte 0 is the action code, then that action's bytes. Readers ignore extra bytes (so a later version can add fields) and unknown codes.
actions.description: Things a controller does during play, sent the moment they happen. Unlike settings, actions are not remembered: each one is a single event.

position.description: Move the paddle to this height, for knobs, sliders and distance sensors. The paddle still moves at its normal speed, like a touch player's, so it isn't faster than buttons. The paddle follows positions until the controller sends UP or DOWN on the movement characteristic (NEUTRAL doesn't count) or positionOff.

positionOff.description: Stop following positions; the paddle stops and listens to UP / DOWN again.

fields.emote: which word to show (index into emotes, optional, default 0)

taunt.description: Show a word over your paddle, with a ring and a sound. At most one every cooldownMs per player; the game ignores the rest. The host can turn taunts off with the In Game Actions switch.

power.description: Power-ups with cooldowns the game enforces.

policies.$comment: House setting: how two different rule requests are settled when a match starts.

sounds.$comment: Built-in sound names for hitSound, scoreSound and winSound. recorded: a file in the game's assets/sounds (credits in its CREDITS.md). synth: made by the game's audio code. original: the 2024 game's sounds.

gong.description: one strike of a cone gong

music.$comment: Built-in music names for the music setting. generated: composed live by the game's music code. recorded: a file in the game's assets/music (credits in its CREDITS.md).

palmleaf.credit: Scott Joplin, rendered by James Brigham

classList.description: The class list each game folder ships with: { "players": [ … ] }. Older games read the same file and ignore fields they don't know.

name.description: The person. Shown in the lobby's list so people can find themselves, and under the controller's name.

controllerName.description: What the game calls this controller everywhere. Comes before the controller's own name setting.

admin.description: Admin panels and games talk through a BroadcastChannel (same browser) or the WebSocket relay (server/relay.js). Every message is a JSON object with a `type`. Games only act on admin:* messages and admins only read game:* messages.
admin.rooms: Every game and admin joins a room (default: the game folder's instance name, e.g. cc26; change it with ?room=…). Rooms never see each other.

admin:rules.description: Changes house rules. Every field is optional and validated by the game.

fields.locks: { key: true } — locked rules ignore what controllers ask for
fields.target: optional game id; without it every game in the room obeys

fields.command: start | pause | resume | reset | lobby | rematch

admin:table.description: Names one game ("Table A"). Ignored without a target.

fields.name: up to 24 characters; empty clears it

admin:hello.description: Asks every game in the room to send its state now.

game:state.description: Sent on every change and at least every 2 seconds.

fields.id: the game's id (kept when its tab reloads)
fields.title: class title
fields.state: lobby | versus | rules | countdown | serve | playing | paused | won
fields.players: for each side: slot, name, person, device, kind, status, gen, color, moveSpeed, paddleSize, requests, sounds, music, issues

feedback.description: The game tells the controller which settings it accepted and why any were refused, so the Serial Monitor can show it.

changes: Experimental: the actions characteristic (19b10013-…), with position (move the paddle to a height, for knobs and sensors), positionOff and taunt.

First written spec. Describes what the 2026 game (cc26) and DFPongController 2.1 do: movement and config characteristics, every setting, built-in sounds and music, house settings, the class list and admin messages.
